I have enough evidence to make the minimal fix. The root cause: in `get_class_members` (sphinx/ext/autodoc/importer.py), inherited members are created as `ObjectMember(unmangled, value)` without `class_=subject`. Later, `ClassDocumenter.get_object_members` filters with `m.class_ == self.object`, so inherited annotation-only attributes (which have no value in the subclass `__dict__`) get dropped. Also, `filter_members` treats members without a docstring as undocumented unless `undoc-members` is set — but for annotation-only attributes the docstring comes from the analyzer's `attr_docs`, which is keyed by the *defining* class, so the inherited member's docstring lookup fails.

Let me check how `filter_members` resolves attribute docstrings.
